name: fusion-jev
description: Recoverable compact coding evidence and bounded Jev choices

interface.shortDescription: Grounded evidence with recoverable compact output.
defaultPrompt: Use Fusion when output would be long or noisy or several files are involved: batch known reads, searches and Git evidence through fusion_inspect; give fusion_assist a short goal; expand receipts with fusion_evidence. Jev selects validated IDs only.

Host owns reasoning, edits, permissions and correctness. Run tests, builds, lint, installs and log commands through fusion-jev run -- program argv... if installed globally, else npx -y fusion-jev@0.3.0 run -- program argv... (in PowerShell write '--'); use RTK/native tools when Fusion is unavailable or unsupported. Continue in the current host on escalation.
